SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consult c
AND c.campus_id = #{campusId} AND c.last_follow_at >= #{start} AND c.last_follow_at < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ) AS consults, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_order o WHERE o.status <> '已作废' ) AS deals, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.receivable), 0) FROM sales_order o WHERE o.status <> '已作废' ) AS receivable, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.received), 0) FROM sales_order o WHERE o.status <> '已作废' ) AS received, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.discount), 0) FROM sales_order o WHERE o.status <> '已作废' ) AS discount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(-p.amount), 0) FROM payment p WHERE p.amount < 0 ) AS refund, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) FROM payment p WHERE 1 = 1 ) AS periodPayments, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.balance), 0) FROM student s AND s.campus_id = #{campusId}) AS balance, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student s WHERE s.status = '在读' AND s.campus_id = #{campusId}) AS activeStudents, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enrollment e WHERE e.status = '生效' AND e.campus_id = #{campusId}) AS enrollmentCount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.remain_lessons), 0) FROM enrollment e WHERE e.status = '生效' AND e.campus_id = #{campusId}) AS remainLessons, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(a.lessons), 0) FROM attendance a ) AS periodLessons, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.debt), 0) FROM sales_order o WHERE o.status <> '已作废' AND o.campus_id = #{campusId}) AS debt, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.received), 0) FROM sales_order o WHERE (o.content LIKE '%资料%' OR o.content LIKE '%教材%' OR o.content LIKE '%杂费%' OR o.content LIKE '%材料%') ) AS materialIncome

SELECT cp.name AS campusName, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.receivable), 0) FROM sales_order o WHERE o.campus_id = cp.id AND o.status <> '已作废' AND o.paid_at >= #{start} AND o.paid_at < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS receivable, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.received), 0) FROM sales_order o WHERE o.campus_id = cp.id AND o.status <> '已作废' AND o.paid_at >= #{start} AND o.paid_at < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS received, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) FROM payment p WHERE p.campus_id = cp.id AND p.paid_at >= #{start} AND p.paid_at < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS payments, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(a.lessons), 0) FROM attendance a WHERE a.campus_id = cp.id AND a.lesson_date >= #{start} AND a.lesson_date <= #{end}) AS lessons, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student s WHERE s.campus_id = cp.id AND s.status = '在读') AS activeStudents FROM campus cp WHERE cp.status = 1 ORDER BY cp.id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS records, COALESCE(SUM(a.lessons), 0) AS lessons, COUNT(DISTINCT a.student_id) AS students, COUNT(DISTINCT a.teacher_id) AS teacherCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = '出勤' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS present, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = '出勤' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 1), 0) AS attendRate FROM attendance a

SELECT COALESCE(sf.name, '未分配') AS teacherName, COALESCE(cp.name, '—') AS campusName, COUNT(*) AS records, COUNT(DISTINCT a.schedule_id) AS schedules, COALESCE(SUM(a.lessons), 0) AS lessons, COUNT(DISTINCT a.class_id) AS classes, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = '出勤' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 1), 0) AS attendRate FROM attendance a LEFT JOIN staff sf ON sf.id = a.teacher_id LEFT JOIN campus cp ON cp.id = a.campus_id
GROUP BY a.teacher_id, sf.name, a.campus_id, cp.name ORDER BY lessons DESC

SELECT COALESCE(co.name, '未知课程') AS courseName, COUNT(DISTINCT a.student_id) AS students, COUNT(*) AS records, COALESCE(SUM(a.lessons), 0) AS lessons FROM attendance a LEFT JOIN class_group cg ON cg.id = a.class_id LEFT JOIN course co ON co.id = cg.course_id
GROUP BY co.id, co.name ORDER BY lessons DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.d, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COALESCE(SUM(t.recv), 0) AS receivable, COALESCE(SUM(t.got), 0) AS received, COALESCE(SUM(t.ref), 0) AS refund, COALESCE(SUM(t.dbt), 0) AS debt FROM ( SELECT DATE(o.paid_at) AS d, o.receivable AS recv, o.received AS got, 0 AS ref, o.debt AS dbt FROM sales_order o
o.status <> '已作废'
UNION ALL SELECT DATE(p.paid_at) AS d, 0, IF(p.amount > 0, p.amount, 0), IF(p.amount < 0, -p.amount, 0), 0 FROM payment p
) t GROUP BY t.d ORDER BY t.d DESC

SELECT o.content AS name, COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(o.receivable), 0) AS receivable, COALESCE(SUM(o.received), 0) AS received FROM sales_order o
(o.content LIKE '%资料%' OR o.content LIKE '%教材%' OR o.content LIKE '%杂费%' OR o.content LIKE '%材料%')
GROUP BY o.content ORDER BY received DESC, count DESC

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student s AND s.campus_id = #{campusId}) AS studentsTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student s WHERE s.status = '在读' AND s.campus_id = #{campusId}) AS activeStudents, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_group cg AND cg.campus_id = #{campusId}) AS classes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schedule sc WHERE sc.lesson_date = CURDATE() AND sc.campus_id = #{campusId}) AS todayClasses, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_order o WHERE o.status <> '已作废' AND o.paid_at >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AND o.paid_at < DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND o.campus_id = #{campusId}) AS monthOrders, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consult c WHERE c.last_follow_at >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AND c.campus_id = #{campusId}) AS monthConsults, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) FROM payment p WHERE p.paid_at >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AND p.paid_at < DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND p.campus_id = #{campusId}) AS monthRevenue, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(a.lessons), 0) FROM attendance a WHERE a.lesson_date >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AND a.campus_id = #{campusId}) AS monthLessons, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.debt), 0) FROM sales_order o WHERE o.status <> '已作废' AND o.campus_id = #{campusId}) AS debt, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.remain_lessons), 0) FROM enrollment e WHERE e.status = '生效' AND e.campus_id = #{campusId}) AS remainLessons

SELECT co.name AS courseName, COUNT(*) AS students, COALESCE(SUM(e.remain_lessons), 0) AS remainLessons FROM enrollment e JOIN course co ON co.id = e.course_id WHERE e.status = '生效' AND e.campus_id = #{campusId} GROUP BY co.name ORDER BY students DESC LIMIT 6
